def generate_orientations():
    # Start with standard die: top=1, bottom=6, front=2, back=5, left=3, right=4
    base = [1,6,2,5,3,4]
    orients = []
    # rotate to put each face on top

        elif top_face == 4:

            rot[2], rot[4], rot[3], rot[5] = rot[4], rot[3], rot[5], rot[2]
            orients.append(tuple(rot))
    return orients
